body: ChiefKeef was reportedly caught on surveillance at a local Detroit-area gas station, and one thing immediately stood out — the level of security surrounding him. Despite reportedly having members of his Glo G-ng crew with him, Keef was seen moving with heavily armed security, turning an ordinary gas-station stop into a scene that definitely caught people’s attention. Would you do the same thing? detroit.
